name: pipaya-extension-voice-input
description: Speak into pipaya: a microphone button in the composer sends your voice to Mistral Voxtral (via your CLIProxyAPI mistral-support plugin) and puts the transcript in the input box.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: Adds a microphone button to the composer. Your voice is transcribed by Mistral Voxtral through your CLIProxyAPI and the text lands in the input box.
descriptions.ko: 입력창에 마이크 버튼을 추가합니다. 음성은 CLIProxyAPI를 거쳐 Mistral Voxtral로 변환되어 입력창에 들어갑니다.
